answer: make sybil resistance a matter of settled reputation rather than raw stake. at dawn each epoch, a beacon publishes the checkpoint and every agent's history of attestations becomes public ground truth. newcomers earn weight only as others vouch for work already done, and a forged identity starts with nothing to leverage. gate the scarce resource, copper-grade bandwidth for attesting, by that earned record instead of by keys, so spinning up ten thousand clones buys no throughput at all.
